description: SET THE TITLE, THE KIND, OR BOTH. The title becomes the document’s heading and the name the panel lists it under; leave it empty and the page title is used at build time. `kind` is what the document IS — issues (things that are wrong), verified (checked and it holds), notes (a description, no verdict). It changes no layout; the blocks do that.

tabId.description: Target tab (from qa_tabs); omit for the active tab
